_note: Every parameter has a base value, a range used in the global sensitivity analysis, and its basis. 'assumption' means no published estimate was found; such parameters are swept over wide ranges.

attack_share.basis: assumption; deceptive requests as a share of all action requests

attack_mix.basis: assumption informed by the relative prominence of spoofing, account compromise, insiders, deepfake meetings and agent manipulation in the incident sources (Section 6.5)

human_detect_text.basis: assumption informed by phishing-susceptibility literature (Section 2.3); probability an employee doubts a deceptive text request

human_detect_media.basis: human deepfake detection is near chance (about 55% accuracy, cited in Ashraf 2026); probability of doubting a synthetic voice/video request

act_on_doubt.basis: assumption; share of doubts acted on (pause or refusal) under ordinary hierarchy pressure

challenge_uplift.basis: assumption; increase in act_on_doubt from protected human challenge (0 = no effect)

training_effect.basis: assumption; relative increase in doubt after awareness training

false_refusal_legit.basis: assumption; legitimate requests refused by the recipient

check_error.basis: assumption; probability that an automated check returns a random level instead of the true level

provenance_coverage.basis: assumption; share of requests arriving on channels that carry verifiable provenance (content credentials are not yet universal)

poison_success.basis: assumption; probability that an A2/A3 attacker obtains a supporting ticket or calendar record created by an independent party, which defeats the independence rule of Section 4.2

callback_catch.basis: assumption; probability that an independent callback exposes a deceptive request (FBI IC3 recommends secondary-channel verification)

callback_catch_insider.basis: assumption; a callback reaches the insider themselves, so it rarely exposes insider requests

dual_catch.basis: assumption; additional probability that a second approver stops a request the callback missed

post_hoc_detection.basis: assumption; share of successful deceptions discovered later and fed back (Eq. 6)

c_h_over_c_d.basis: illustrative cost ratio, as in Eq. (7)
